lane: Mobile + AI client: Tarot reader suggestion by intent and free personal note (batch C remainder, proposal sections 1-2, Owner approved 23/11)
goal: Suggest the Tarot follow-up reader from the user's topic, question words and drawn cards instead of the deck alone, with an optional AI tie-break for signed-in users, a once-per-spread mismatch nudge, and show the free daily personal note (note mode of ai-tarot-reading) under the summary on the Tarot result screen, with privacy-safe product events.
successCriteria: suggestTarotReader is a pure on-device rule engine: chosen topic (largest weight), Vietnamese with and without diacritics and English question keywords, card facts (Cups, Swords, Majors) and a small deck tie-breaker; it returns primary, two alternatives, confidence 0..1, matchedTopic, reason key/params and two openers.
The Owner's two failure cases are fixed: a work question no longer suggests Inner Child Healer and a love question no longer suggests Clear Strategist; at least 25 Jest cases pass.

When confidence is low and the user is signed in, the app asks ai-tarot-reading suggest_reader with a 4 s timeout; the slug is used only if it is a candidate and the user has not tapped yet; the rule result shows first and on any error.

The reader panel shows the detected topic chips, the main suggestion with a reason naming the question topic and 1-2 drawn cards, two match lines, two opener buttons, two alternatives, 'Xem tất cả người dẫn' and an AI-character footnote; vi and en.
Picking a reader whose themes do not match the detected topic shows a non-blocking sheet once per spread with 'Vẫn hỏi' / 'Đổi sang'.

Signed-in users get one note request after the reveal with states writing, note, guest, used today, error/offline, crisis (115 card); canned text is never shown as AI; the existing deep reading flow, quotas and paywall are unchanged.
sendProductEvent posts enumerated metadata only (no free text) to /share/events, fire-and-forget.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, SQL, migrations, routes, quotas, switches and secrets are unchanged; the note and suggest_reader server modes are built by another agent and need Owner-approved deploys.
The share-events server allowlist is extended by another agent; until then product events are rejected quietly.
Deep reading flow, Tarot quotas, paywall and the 9-part report (later batch) are unchanged.
Tarot card selection stays deterministic server/app logic; AI never chooses cards.
PLAN.md is updated by the coordinating agent, not in this task.

impact.entryPoint: Tarot > result screen: the note box under 'Tóm lại'; the reader panel replaces the deck-only guide selector under the result; 'Hỏi tiếp' in the dock uses the selected reader.
impact.dataWrite: Local component state only (note state per drawId, nudge shown per reading id). No AsyncStorage, seed or table changes on the device side.
impact.backendContract: ai-tarot-reading gains client calls {action:'note', drawId} and {action:'suggest_reader', drawId, candidates}; product events post {events:[{name, ...enumerated metadata}]} to /share/events. Both server sides are delivered separately.
impact.adminVisibility: Events land in usage_events once the server allowlist accepts them; Admin shows counts only.
impact.privacySafety: The rule engine runs on the device and sends nothing. The AI calls send only drawId and candidate slugs; the server already holds the question. Events carry enumerated values, never question text. Crisis responses show the existing 115 card.
impact.rollback: Revert the app commit; server modes absent or failing leave the rule result and the note error state; no data migration.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/personas-archetypes.json stays the source of persona themes
apps/mobile/src/backendClient.ts stays the single mobile caller of ai-tarot-reading

managerTestPath: Signed in: draw Công việc with the question 'Sếp mới hay soi, mình có nên xin chuyển nhóm?'. Under 'Tóm lại' the personal note box writes then shows; tap Đúng. Below, the reader panel suggests Clear Strategist with a reason naming công việc and a drawn card; tap Inner Child Healer in 'Xem tất cả người dẫn' and see the one-time nudge; tap an opener and chat opens with that text. Signed out: the note box invites sign-in.
residualRisk: Server note and suggest_reader modes and the event allowlist are not deployed yet, so on staging the note shows its error state and events are dropped until they ship; device behaviour (TalkBack order, large text, reduce motion) is not verified on a phone.
